services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: There’s no comparing the awe-inspiring nature of a museum visit to a typical day in the classroom. Bring your students to experience hands-on, real world examples of science and the maritime industry. On site field trips include self-guided tours of the Museum and the Battleship Wisconsin, films in the Brock Theater and more. Nauticus expert educators will lead students through classroom curriculum and engaging hands-on STEM programs. Our programs are a great way to enhance your field trip to Nauticus!
